title: Pad kra pao (chicken with Thai basil and fried egg)
steps: Cook the rice according to the packet.
Finely chop the chicken, pound the garlic and chilli in a mortar and cut the beans into short pieces.
Fry the garlic and chilli in 1 tsp oil for 30 seconds, add the chicken and fry for 4 minutes until crumbly, adding the beans for 2 minutes.
Add the sauces and sugar and fold in the basil until wilted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until crisp and serve with rice and the chicken.
